outcome: breastfeeding challenges motivating pumping (e.g., supply, engorgement, latch)
emotional response to discarding breast milk
cohort: U.S. individuals who delivered a term infant within the previous 13 months and ever provided pumped breast milk to their infant.
finding: The study observed shifts toward early (day-of-delivery) and regular postpartum pumping practices, with higher pumping frequency (>=4 times daily) associated with significantly more upset feelings about discarding breast milk.
cross-section timing: Participants reported on pumping practices from delivery up to the time of the survey, conducted when their infant was up to 13 months old (median 6 months).
